text:
Ana: Quick sync — I'm drafting the latency deep-dive for infra review. Need canonical links/panels for p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec, and preferred PromQL slices. Also want callouts for alert tuning (p95 -> paging?) and a quick CR for the prom queries I changed. Ping me w/ links or copy snippets.

Kevin: Use Grafana -> 'LLM/Latency Overview' -> panel 'TTFT by model' and 'Token/sec heatmap'. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/abcd123/llm-latency
PromQL for p95 TTFT (per-route):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
I changed a query in git: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/observability/-/merge_requests/42 — please review.

Miko: For paging, let's keep p95 alert to SEV2 and p99 to SEV1 for production routes only. Also add a 'tokens/sec drop' alert when tokens/sec < baseline for 5m and errors spike.

Ana: @Kevin I'll review MR today. @Miko can you add recommended thresholds? Also where to find sample Jaeger traces for slow TTFT calls?

Kevin: Jaeger trace link: https://jaeger.redwood.io/trace/abcd-ttft-sample
Look for span 'serve.token_generation' and 'kv-cache-miss'. If KV cache miss correlates with >200ms added.

OpsBot: deploy-bot posted: 'Prometheus queries updated in observability repo (mr 42) — CI passed.' :white_check_mark:

Miko: Suggested thresholds in doc snippet:
```
p95_ttft_alert: >800ms for prod routes over 10m
p99_ttft_alert: >1500ms for prod routes over 5m (page)
tokens_rate_drop: tokens/sec < 50% baseline for 5m + error_rate > 0.5%
```
I'll open a follow-up MR to add those to alertmanager.

Ana: Awesome — I'll add dashboard bookmarks and a short runbook section (how to triage using TTFT panel, tokens heatmap, and Jaeger spans). If anyone has a quick checklist for oncall handoff, drop it here.

Kevin: Quick checklist:
- Check TTFT p95/p99 & tokens/sec panel
- Inspect top routes by token/sec drop
- Open Jaeger trace for worst requests
- Check KV cache miss rate and fallback model usage
- If p99 > threshold and errors up, escalate to eng-runtime

Miko: tagging @oncall next rotation: please review dashboards and policy before Monday. :calendar:

Ana: thanks all :heart:
